title: PILLAGERS DRAWN A THIRD THE SIZE
why: His note of 2026-10-25, played on an older copy: player character is still wayyy too big, needs to be 1/3 of the size he is right now. Every human figure (both players, the pillager bots, hires, the survivor, the peddler, downed and falling bodies, the Undercroft crowd) is drawn at a third of the v33.22 size, FIG_SCALE 1/3, drawing only: hit areas, walking, doors and the nav grid keep their old radius. FIG_UP now follows FIG_SCALE, so every plate and tag keeps the gap over the head it had on the size 1 figure. Things placed for the full size body follow it: the side mark, the world muzzle flash with the tracer start and the brass, the forge glow, the DEMO spawn shield, the power shield bubble, the waterline, the HUD plates over your head (cook, reload, seal, forge), the get-up bar, the peddler pack frame, the fall shadow and the ascent sink. The P1 and P2 seat ring and the red downed ring keep their full size so they still read. In the pixel look (its own size, PIX_FIGK) the aim dots no longer take FIG_SCALE, so they start at the pixel gun.
now: Every pillager, bot, hire and body is drawn a third of the old size (drawing only: hit areas, walking and doors keep their old size). Name plates, party tags, the reload bar, the shields and the muzzle flash follow the smaller body; the P1 and P2 seat rings and the red downed ring keep their full size so they still read. Watch for: the small body being hard to spot in a fight, shots landing a little wide of the drawing (the hit circle is now much bigger than the body), the crowbar reaching further than its swing looks, tracers starting a little above the gun, and faces, beards and eye colours in the Undercroft crowd too small to read.
